notes: AR 2015 mirrors the AR 2010 structure (Title 21 Ch. 8 ethics + Title 10 Ch. 1 legislative). Tree depth required pass-3 fetches because Title 21 Ch. 8 is a chapter directory exposing 10 subchapters which in turn expose section-level leaves. One intermediate fetch was added at Title 21 Ch. 8 between pass-2 (title) and pass-3 (subchapter sections) — recorded as a pass-2 fetch (pass2_chapter-8.tsv) so the helper-saved TSVs naming stays consistent. Pass-3 also dropped Subch. 1 from the pass-2 selection: its 'General Provisions' name was misleading — its sections (§ 21-8-101 Nepotism, § 21-8-102 former-employee restrictions) are out of lobbying scope, and definitions for the regime actually live at § 21-8-402 inside Subch. 4. Final URL count: 16 (15 Title 21 + 1 Title 10), vs the AR 2010 prior's 5+1 — the 2015 tree exposes the same regime at deeper section granularity (each Subch. 4 and Subch. 6 section is its own page in 2015), so URL count differences reflect Justia's page granularity, not statute differences.
